title: Free Throw
description: Shoot hoops against the clock: drag back, release and sink as many baskets as you can in 60 seconds. Free basketball game in your browser.
about:
Free Throw is a fast basketball shooting challenge set in an indoor arena. You have sixty seconds to score as many baskets as possible. Every new ball appears at a different spot on the court, so each shot needs a slightly different arc.

Drag back from anywhere on the screen and a dotted line shows the path of your shot; release to throw. The ball bounces realistically off the rim and the backboard, so near misses can still roll in. A clean swish that touches nothing but net is worth an extra point, shots from behind the three-point line are worth three, and every three baskets in a row add a streak bonus.

Your best score is saved, so you can keep coming back to beat it.
howToPlay: Press anywhere, drag back and release to shoot: the direction and length of the drag set the angle and the power, as shown by the dotted line. Normal baskets are worth 2 points, three-pointers 3, a swish adds 1 and streaks add more. Score as much as you can before the 60 seconds run out.
tips: A high arc is more forgiving than a flat shot.
Aim for the back half of the rim; the backboard can help short shots go in.
Do not rush: a made basket is worth more than two quick misses.
Keep your streak alive for bonus points on every basket.

faq.question: Is Free Throw free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Free Throw is free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play Free Throw on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Drag back with your finger and release to shoot. It works in portrait and landscape; landscape shows more of the court.

faq.question: How are points scored?
faq.answer: 2 points for a basket, 3 from behind the three-point line, +1 for a swish that does not touch the rim or backboard, and a growing bonus for baskets in a row.
